title: Zettai Karen Children
synopsis: In the future, as people with ESP increase in numbers, so does the possible good and evil they can cause to society. The Japanese government establishes of the Base of Backing ESP Laboratory (BABEL), a special esper organization tasked with dealing with situations that can't be resolved by ordinary means, including dealing with espers engaged in criminal activity. Prodigy Kouichi Minamoto is assigned by BABEL to the task of supervising the most powerful espers in the country, a trio of gifted but mischievous young girls known as "The Children". The Children and Minamoto must deal with several enemy organizations, each with conflicted views regarding the role of espers in the world, including "PANDRA", a cadre of rogue espers determined to wage war against the rest of mankind; "Black Phantom", a mercenary organization who brainwashes espers into living tools of destruction; and the "Normal People", composed solely of non-esper individuals who view espers only as a threat to be vanquished. (Source: Wikipedia) Included one-shot: Volume 1: Zettai Karen Children (pilot)

title: NINE PEAKS
synopsis: Gaku Mashio was a first-year high school student who lived with his father. He lost his father in a sudden accident, just as he got suspended from school after getting into a fight. On the night of his father's wake, Gaku went fishing on the shore in memory of his father, but he fell into the sea and was returned 22 years into the past. Gaku's father, Harumi, who was the same age as Gaku at that time, saved him from the water. Harumi's parents (Gaku's grandparents) took a liking to Gaku, and accepted him into their family under the name Gaku Miyagi. His grandparents even encouraged him to go to Seiha High School, same as his father. Twenty-two years ago, the town of Kurei was full of delinquents. Now Gaku and his father will fight their way to the top of the town! (Source: Shonen Champion, translated)

synopsis: Alban realizes that he had been reincarnated as the “villainous nobleman” of a fantasy novel. Just as he starts rigorously training in sword and sorcery so that he would not be defeated by the hero, Alban finds out that Leticia, the daughter of the villain, is to be his bride! Leticia is a young lady who is the subject of many unsavory rumors! He was scared to see what kind of “bad girl” she would be… But when he meets her, she seems pure and beautiful as an angel, almost like his ideal woman. Alban is so smitten that he forgets all about his plan to avoid the bad ending. He decides to strike back at the mastermind behind his beloved wife's downfall! Using their own villainous reputation to their advantage, he sets a trap to lure out the culprit......? (Source: Corona EX, translated)

synopsis: Takane Kiku and Takane Ryuji are the children of a legendary world contender boxer. Kiku, the daughter seems to have inherited her father's boxing sense and tries to teach Ryuji to become a world contender. However, Ryuji hates boxing and gets picked on. After Kiku and Ryuji leave their hometown for Tokyo, Ryuji eventually learns to discover a passion for boxing after an encounter with a boxing prodigy, Kenzaki Jun. This will eventually lead him to learn crazy moves and out of this world opponents to become one of Japan's top junior boxers. (Source: Anime News Network)
